# MeedyaDL 1.9.2

A single-issue follow-up to 1.9.1 that quiets a false alarm in the queue's stuck-download safety net.

### What's fixed

- **The "no progress signal — item may be stuck" warning no longer fires during normal, long-running lyrics conversion.** On big libraries, converting synced lyrics for every track in an album can take a while and doesn't move the on-screen progress bar. MeedyaDL's stuck-download watchdog used to mistake that quiet stretch for a stall and warn you unnecessarily. It now also watches for any Activity log activity for that download, so genuine progress no longer trips a false alarm — while a truly frozen download still gets caught and flagged.
